title: 布隆·雪岭之盾
description: 布隆穿保暖完整衣装站在雪岭，巨大门盾稳立身侧，大胡子与宽阔肩背在强烈雪光中清楚分层。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Braum is a very broad adult Freljordian man with a bald head, huge curled brown moustache, kind focused eyes, and an immense muscular build. Preserve his characteristic face and door-like carved shield while covering his torso with a substantial warm tunic beneath fur-edged outerwear, opaque trousers, gloves, and boots. The gigantic shield stands grounded beside him, held calmly without a blocking action.
art_direction.scene: He stands at a broad snowy mountain overlook, one hand resting on the shield's upper edge and the other lowered beside his leg. The pose communicates steadfast warmth without a grin exaggerated into a mascot. Strong reflected snowlight and a hard amber rim divide heavy wax-crayon shapes, with distant ridges and enormous clean sky behind the complete figure.
art_direction.palette: snow ivory, cobalt shadow, warm brown, amber light
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
